title: unify-sdks-auth-retries-streaming-parity-v1.176.0
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: SDKs: unify auth/retries/streaming APIs across Python/TS/Go, ergonomics improvements, parity fixes, bump to v1.176.0
description:
Context: This PR unifies auth, retry, and streaming ergonomics across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs, addresses parity gaps discovered during v1.175.0 rollouts, and bumps SDK package versions to v1.176.0.

Motivation: Customers reported inconsistent retry behavior between SDKs and missing streaming backpressure ergonomics; this resulted in support tickets (SUP-9123) and a small incident where streaming reconnects caused duplicate partial messages. Unifying implementation reduces maintenance burden and ensures consistent behavior across language bindings.

What changed: - Standardized auth token refresh hooks and caching across all SDKs. - Introduced unified retry policy config and backoff algorithm with explicit jitter. - Improved streaming client ergonomics: explicit 'on_data' callback, async iterator parity, cancelation semantics. - Fixed parity bugs: Go incorrectly re-used transport on 401, TS streamed events emitted before handshake completion, Python's retry middleware swallowed 429 metadata. - Version bump and changelogs for each package.

Commits: 6 commits: 1) initial unify design and interfaces; 2) py: implement auth/retry middleware; 3) ts: adapt streaming client and retrier; 4) go: transport and auth refresh fixes; 5) tests and e2e; 6) bump versions and changelogs.

Files changed (high level): libs/sdk-python/src/auth.py; libs/sdk-python/src/retries.py; libs/sdk-python/src/streaming.py; libs/sdk-typescript/src/auth.ts; libs/sdk-typescript/src/retries.ts; libs/sdk-typescript/src/streaming.ts; libs/sdk-go/auth/auth.go; libs/sdk-go/retries/retries.go; docs/sdk/changelog.md; tests/{python,typescript,go}/test_retry_policy.py|ts|go. Small illustrative diff: updated retry backoff to use full-jitter algorithm and added token cache TTL check.

Testing: Unit tests added for each SDK (retry edge cases, token refresh race), e2e convergence tests run in perf lab against streaming echo server with flaky network. Local integration: ran redwood-integration pipeline for SDK packages. CI: all checks passed after one flaky TS test re-run.

Review summary: Miguel Santos requested clearer config names and inline examples; addressed in commit 3. Ava Chen suggested stronger test coverage for 401/refresh races; added deterministic race tests. Jordan Blake approved with comments around changelog phrasing; minor wording updated.

CI summary: build (python/ts/go): pass; unit tests: pass (1 flaky TS test rerun); lint: pass; e2e: pass; publish dry-run: pass.

Merge: merged via squash on 2026-02-27 after approvals from Miguel, Ava, Jordan. Release: packages published to internal registry and tags created: sdk-python/v1.176.0, sdk-typescript/v1.176.0, sdk-go/v1.176.0. Post-merge follow-ups: throttle config doc update (ENG-1771), monitor streaming error-rate during canary rollout.

Related: linked Linear ENG-1764, ENG-1771; Support ticket SUP-9123.
